approvedFacts.text: Molly Hatchet is the debut studio album by American rock band Molly Hatchet.
It was released on September 1, 1978, by Epic Records.
The cover is a painting by Frank Frazetta entitled Death Dealer.
Molly Hatchet is an American rock band formed by guitarist Dave Hlubek in Jacksonville, Florida in 1971.
The band released six studio albums on Epic Records between 1978 and 1984, including the platinum-selling hit records Molly Hatchet (1978), Flirtin' with Disaster (1979) and Beatin' the Odds (1980).
